questions.prompt: How do you typically handle a rejected Promise in a chain?

options.text: Rejections cannot be handled in JavaScript

questions.explanation: `.catch` handles rejections in the Promise chain (and rejection handlers in `.then` can too).

questions.prompt: In `new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ... })`, when do `.then` callbacks run?

options.text: Synchronously inside the executor, before it returns
Later as microtasks after the Promise settles

questions.explanation: `resolve`/`reject` settle the Promise; `.then` reactions are scheduled as microtasks afterward.
